proof_groups.proof_strategy: Select the natural disjunct for each generated OR. For entail_wit_1, open xizi_dll and split its full segment at node by induction on nodes_before. For both return witnesses, rebuild that segment with the shared reverse helper. In return_wit_1, node_next = head forces nodes_after = nil; in return_wit_2, node_next <> head and xizi_dllseg_unfold force nodes_after to begin with node_next. Use the second expanded return-post disjunct to reuse first/last directly.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: The three witnesses are a single middle-node decomposition lifecycle: one creates the split shape and two consume/reassemble it. They share the same helper family and proof context, have no dependency on another group, and the group size 3 is within the limit 12.

per_witness_plan.proof_of_xizi_double_link_next_rec_middl: Choose the first OR branch, open xizi_dll, apply the split helper, and instantiate node_next/node_prev/first/last.
Choose the expanded second OR branch, prove nodes_after=nil from the sentinel-start suffix, simplify next_value, rebuild, and instantiate first_2/last_2.
Choose the expanded second OR branch, obtain the suffix-head equation with xizi_dllseg_unfold, simplify next_value, rebuild, and instantiate first_2/last_2.

premise_discharge.head_nonnull: PreH4 in both return VCs; the leading xizi_dll conjunct in the entail VC.
premise_discharge.suffix_equal_branch: PreH1 and PreH2 rewrite node_next to head; unfolding a nonempty xizi_dllseg at stop contradicts its node <> stop guard.
premise_discharge.suffix_unequal_branch: PreH1 and PreH2 give node_next <> head, exactly the premise of xizi_dllseg_unfold.
premise_discharge.middle_rebuild: All prefix, selected-node, suffix, and sentinel link resources are present under separating conjunction.
